programme.title: Saschiz Old Town, Romania
programme.desc: Saschiz, village, and commune, Mureș județ county is located in central Romania. The villages of Saschiz, Mihai Viteazu, and Cloașterf make up the larger commune of Saschiz. Located in the old region of Transylvania, it lies about 20 km east of Sighișoara"&". First documented in the 14th century, Saschiz is known for its medieval fortress and church constructed by Transylvanian Saxons, a German speaker. They settled in Transylvania when it was part of Hungary. The ruins of the 14th-century fortress sit atop "&"a hill overlooking the village. The late 15th-century fortified church has Gothic details and an imposing clock tower. Along with five other villages with fortified churches, Saschiz was inscribed on UNESCO’s World Heritage sites in 1999.

He encounters a man saying "see the wonders of the moon for ten cents," and offering a sight through a telescope. Casper scares the man away, then uses the telescope to see the moon. He then flies to the moon for a visit. Casper lands on the moon, disappointed to find no man on the moon. He lies down to nap, then tiny moon men emerge from holes. They capture Casper, like Lilliputians did to Gulliver, then place him in a cage on wheels, in which they tow him to the Ruler of the Moon, King Luna. Then animated trees attack the city of the moon men. The moon men defend their fortified city with flaming missiles. The tree monsters fight back with water, then break through the town walls. When the fight seems lost to the tree monsters, Casper escapes his cage, and helps the moon men. Casper goes underground. The friendly ghost then pulls trees' parts through the moon surface and ties them together, immobilizing the trees. The frustrated trees writhe and strain against the knots Casper has tied. Casper and the moon men have won. Then, and only then, does King Luna embrace Casper as a friend. King Luna knights Casper for the valiant defense of his people. Then all the moon men join in singing the Casper theme song.

programme.title: Robinhood Makes Good 1939
programme.desc: Three little squirrels act out the story of Robin Hood. A fox, thinking he can make a meal out of them, joins in. The squirrels have to find a way to get rid of the fox.

programme.title: Birth of a Notion 1947
programme.desc: Daffy Duck cons a dog named Leopold into offering him a stay in his house, but he has to hide Daffy from his master, a Peter-Lorre style mad scientist who needs a duck's wishbone.

programme.title: Superman cartoons 3
programme.desc: Superman cartoons 3

programme.title: Scotty Finds a Home 1935
programme.desc: A young anthropomorphic kitten wants a pet. He happens to find a puppy with no owner and takes him in. When the Scotty tracks mud into the house, Grandma says that her grandson cannot keep him. A transient bulldog is walking by as Grandma puts a pie in the windowsill to cool. He barges into the house and terrorizes the family, demanding they feed him. Scotty rushes back to the house and saves the family, causing Grandma to decide that they can keep him after all.

programme.title: Gold Rush Daze 1939
programme.desc: A man stops for gas on his way to dig for gold. The man at the station tells him what it was like back in 1849 in San Francisco, which we see. A sucker is hauled off the street and sat down at a card game; he dashes off as soon as someone shouts "they found gold in the hills" but others stake claims before he can. He ends up chopping off a cliff, falling down, and landing in the hospital. The doctor gives him news of another gold strike and he rushes out to begin panning. After some more mining gags and a song, we see a montage of more failed gold strikes. Back to the present day, where the storyteller claims to have sworn off gold, until a rider passes through with news of another strike, when he trades the station for the car and sets out after the gold.

programme.title: I Don't Scare 1956
programme.desc: Popeye has beaten Bluto to a date with Olive. Seeing that Olive is superstitious, Bluto changes the date to Friday the 13th, and proceeds to rig various proofs that bad things will happen if she goes out.

programme.title: Insect to Injury 1956
programme.desc: Popeye tries to get rid of termites before they ruin his newly built house.

programme.title: Me Musical Nephews 1942
programme.desc: Popeye's nephews have been practicing their music and are getting good, but it's bedtime. After Popeye puts them to bed, they discover that many of the things in their bedroom can also be used to make music. And they are also blessed with an uncanny ability to appear to sleep every time Popeye comes to check on them

programme.title: Educated Fish-1937
programme.desc: A rebellious fish refuses to listen to his teacher until he ventures out into the real world and discovers the importance of education.

programme.title: Pudgy and the Lost Kitten 1938
programme.desc: Pudgy and the Lost Kitten

programme.title: The Underground World-1943
programme.desc: Lois Lane and an explorer set out on an expedition through an underground cavern and discover a race of hawk-men. When these creatures prepare a ritual sacrifice for the adventurous pair, Superman comes to the rescue.

programme.title: A Spanish Twist 1932
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry (the human versions, not the cat and mouse) are on a raft in the ocean. After being attacked by an octopus and losing their raft, they wash up on the shores of Spain. After harassing the waitresses at a local sidewalk café, they insult the owner and wind up in a bull ring as punishment. In the midst of fighting dozens of bulls, they receive a telegram that Prohibition has been repealed back in the U.S. They immediately leave Spain headed back to the U.S. for a drink

programme.title: Tulips Shall Grow 1942 (madcap models no. u1-5)
programme.desc: A carefree boy and a young girl find their idyllic countryside invaded by an army of mindlessly destructive robots.

programme.title: Betty Boop with Henry the Funniest Living American-1935
programme.desc: Henry, comic strip character, gets a job at Betty Boop's pet store

programme.title: Page Miss Glory 1936
programme.desc: A bellhop in the No 1. hotel of a smalltown awaiting the arrival of Miss Glory dreams he has to page Miss Glory at a first class hotel in New York, and this turns out to be a nightmare. Finally he is awakened by the manager, because Miss Glory's car has arrived, but instead of a beautiful lady, a child star a la Shirley Temple steps out ...

programme.title: spooking about africa 2 (1080)
programme.desc: Casper is in an African jungle. He frightens a zebra at a watering hole. Wheezy the elephant has a terrible sneezing problem; he sneezes all the feathers off a peacock and a group of monkeys out of their perches. Casper decides to help, and in the process dislodges the feather that was making the elephant sneeze. But then a fire breaks out, and the elephant is unable to sneeze on command

programme.title: Fireman's Life, A-1933
programme.desc: Fireman's Life

programme.title: Ancient Fistory 1953
programme.desc: It's the middle ages (sort of); Popeye is working in Bluto's Beanery. Bluto is going to the ball where Princess Olive will choose her mate. Popeye's fairy godpappy appears and it's a reverse Cinderella story, with a car created from a can of spinach.

programme.title: In the Bag-1932
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry crash their plane in the cartoon wild, wild west. Surreal hi-jinx involving a vicious outlaw and robbery ensue.

programme.title: Little Boy Blue 1936
programme.desc: The Big Bad Wolf stalks Little Bo Peep and steals one of her sheep. She enlists Little Boy Blue and a dancing scarecrow to assist her and her mischievous black sheep in rescuing it. Singing, dancing, hilarity and impalement ensue.

programme.title: The Playful Polar Bears-1938
programme.desc: A joyfully contented group of polar bears encounter danger when hunters arrive.

programme.title: Little Nemo-1911
programme.desc: Little Nemo-1911

programme.desc: In his master's eyes, "good old Shep" is the perfect dog, but the cat knows he's really a two-faced mutt who can be bought off with a bone by a burglar, and then take credit for it when the cat chases the crook off. But then Shep becomes obsessed by a newspaper story proclaiming a real canine hero the nation's "No. 1 Dog."

programme.title: Assault and Flattery 1956
programme.desc: Bluto is accusing Popeye in judge Wimpy's courtroom. Bluto tells a sad tale of how Popeye attacked him without provocation, but Popeye tells his side, in detail (in other words, a large chunk of _Balmy Swami, A (1949)_)

programme.title: Pepe le-Pew - Heaven Scent 1956
programme.desc: On the French Riviera, a female cat is frightened by sudden outbursts of barking by every dog around her. So, to scare them away, she paints her back with a white stripe like that of a skunk. The dogs, on seeing her stripe, run away and hide in fright. But she doesn't receive the peace she'd expected, because Pepe Le Pew, the amorous French skunk, sees her, thinks she's a girl skunk, and tries to make love to her.

programme.title: Tulips Shall Grow 1942
programme.desc: A carefree boy and a young girl find their idyllic countryside invaded by an army of mindlessly destructive robots.

programme.title: Goo Goo Goliath 1954
programme.desc: An inebriated stork must deliver a baby to a giant at the top of a beanstalk, but doesn't feel like flying that high and instead delivers the baby to a normal-sized couple, who try to raise the giant tot as their own.

programme.title: By Word of Mouse 1954
programme.desc: A foreign mouse comes to America and is amazed by its economic system. He goes to a mouse professor who explains how it works while they are being chased by Sylvester.

programme.title: You Can't Shoe a Horse Fly 1940
programme.desc: Hunky and Spunky are settling in for a nap, but a horse fly sees them and sees dinner. After battling the fly for a while, the youngster enlists dad's help. But the fly is merely stunned, and rallies a new attack, this time with friends. Father eventually kills the lot of them

programme.title: Bride and Gloom
programme.desc: Popeye is marrying Olive tomorrow; he's ecstatic. She has a dream of the future, including twin sons who prove to be a real handful. When Popeye comes by the next morning, he gets a frosty reception

programme.title: Nearly Weds 1957
programme.desc: Popeye and Bluto both plan to marry Olive Oyl, but Popeye proposes first. When Olive says, "Yes!" to Popeye, Bluto sets out to make Popeye look bad, break up the wedding, and win Olive over.

programme.title: Betty Boop Is My Palm Read -1932
programme.desc: For customer Betty Boop, psychic reader Prof. Bimbo conjures up an adventure on a haunted tropical island in his crystal ball

programme.title: popeye meets ali baba's forty thieves (1080)
programme.desc: Popeye the Sailor, accompanied by Olive Oyl and Wimpy, is dispatched to stop the dreaded bandit Abu Hassan and his force of forty thieves

programme.title: Now Hear This 1962
programme.desc: In this very abstract cartoon, a hard-of-hearing old Britisher finds a red horn and uses it as a megaphone, unaware that it is really a lost horn from the Devil's forehead. The Britisher finds that the horn has the effect of amplifying every sound psychedelically and causing him serious bodily harm

programme.title: Trolley Ahoy-1936
programme.desc: Mr. Bang bets the Skipper ten dollars he can't get the trolley to arrive at the train station on time.

programme.title: Gopher Spinach 1954
programme.desc: Popeye battles a gopher over his precious spinach plants.

programme.title: The Good Egg 1939
programme.desc: A hen adopts an abandoned egg which hatches into a turtle. The baby turtle becomes the butt of all the real chicks' jokes until danger threatens

programme.title: Ride Him, Bosko -1931
programme.desc: BosKo in the Wild West, tries to have fun with any situation that come in his way.

programme.title: Boom Boom-1936
programme.desc: World War I, apparently. There is a series of quick blackout gags, including a soldier that throws the pin, is blown sky-high by the grenade, and is caught in a net by an ambulance driver; one soldier's encounters with very smart bullets; a machine gunner with the jitters. Porky leads a charge, but with no support from his company, he runs back and dives under Beans' bunk. After a quick chorus of "You're in the Army Now," a messenger pigeon drops in with news that General Hardtack is being held prisoner. They dash off in a motorcycle/sidecar, chased by another smart bullet, and arrive in the nick of time to dispatch the general's captors. They fly off in a plane and get shot down to end up together in the hospital.

programme.title: Private eye popeye (1080)
programme.desc: Private Eye Popeye gets a call from Olive Oyl to guard a precious gem. But no sooner does he get the gem than the butler takes it (and Olive). The rest of the cartoon is spent chasing the crook to Paris, the Swiss Alps, and North Africa; Popeye always gets there first, but fails to make the arrest until he lucks into some spinach, of course

programme.title: Wild Wife 1954
programme.desc: A harried housewife describes to her boorish husband what she did that day.

programme.title: Felix in the Bone Age-1922
programme.desc: Felix comes upon a caveman and his girlfriend. The girlfriend is crying, and when the caveman asks her what she wants, she points to Felix. The caveman chases Felix, who escapes by using the tails of some friendly monkeys to make his way down a steep cliff. Later he makes friends with a baby monkey, but winds up getting in a fight with a huge gorilla.

programme.title: Boy Meets Dog 1938
programme.desc: A commercial short made for the Bristol-Myers Co. (plugging their toothpaste) that features the characters from the "Reg'lar Fellers" syndicated newspaper comic strip by Gene Byrnes. The plot concerns a boy who has an old grouch for a daddy, runs off, meets a dog and joins a gang of kids. Meanwhile,the old man has a nightmare,where he sees himself as an old sour puss because he doesn't take care of his teeth and gums. He sees an electric sign for Bristol-Myers toothpaste, and that sets him on a more positive course. (The few-seconds of film showing the sign represents the only commercial intrusion in this short)

programme.title: Campus Capers 1949
programme.desc: This one features a cat-versus-mouse football game between two cat-and-mouse colleges, called Harbard and Quinceton, and there is nothing Ivy-League about either school. The highlights are a screwy college fight-song and a statute-of-liberty misdirection football play in which the Statute of Liberty participates.

programme.title: The Booze Hangs High-1930
programme.desc: Bosko has a grand time on the farm, dancing with a cow, playing a horse's tail like a violin and getting drunk with three pigs

programme.title: Crowing Pains 1947
programme.desc: Foghorn convinces Henery that Sylvester is a chicken. Foghorn sticks Henery in an egg and sticks it under Sylvester.

programme.title: Betty Boop- More Pep- 1936
programme.desc: In a return to the 'Out of the Inkwell' format, Betty Boop invents a 'pep' formula to speed up lazy Pudgy, but it escapes into the 'real world' with rapid results.

programme.title: Superman: The Magnetic Telescope- 1942
programme.desc: When police interfere with a reckless scientist's experiment, it creates a deadly meteor shower only Superman can stop.

programme.title: Felix Lends a Hand 1922
programme.desc: Trudging through the snow in his hometown, Felix sees a billboard advertising sunny Egypt, and says that he'd give four of his nine lives to be there rather than freezing in the snow. He then hears crying coming from his friend Abdul's carpet shop, and it turns out that Abdul's girlfriend has been kidnapped by an Egyptian sheik. Felix promises to rescue her, and hops on a magic carpet Abdul has lying around the shop, says the magic word and flies off to Egypt to keep his promise.

programme.title: Land of the Lost Jewels 1950
programme.desc: Two children are fishing when they catch a talking fish named Red Lantern. He takes them underwater with him to the Land of the Lost, where missing items can be found again. They meet King Find All, a walrus, and a singing cricket (Hoppy-Go-Lucky) that used to be the girl's pin. He's deemed to be a special jewel (since he's made of emerald) and is brought to the jewel storage room, despite his wishes to be in the Land of the Toys. He runs away from Queen Tiara's guards, but is caught, and when they test him for authenticity they find he is only a fake diamond, after which he is allowed to live in the Land of the Toys after all. The children return to the surface and say goodbye to Red Lantern.

programme.desc: Felix the Cat and his two nephews try to have a picnic, but a thunderstorm and a thieving rabbit prevent them.

programme.title: The Return of Mr. Hook -1945
programme.desc: Seaman Hook has big plans for after the war, mostly involving rushing home and marrying his sweetie. So do his fellow seaman, but theirs involve buying bond

programme.desc: Felix is reading a book about Fairyland, and decides that it must be a wonderful place to be. Suddenly he hears a cry for help, and finds a fly stuck on a piece of flypaper. programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including multiple Emmy, Peabody and Edward R. Murrow Awards.

programme.title: CBS News Things That Matter
programme.sub-title: A Town Hall with the Artemis Astronauts
programme.desc: CBS News 24/7 is your trusted source for live National and Local breaking news and in-depth reporting on the issues shaping your world.

programme.title: CBS Weekend News
programme.desc: Journalist Adriana Diaz anchors the Saturday edition of the CBS news program from Chicago, while Jericka Duncan takes the helm of the Sunday broadcast from New York. The two are the latest to fill the roll of weekend anchor, which was most recently represented by Reena Ninan and Eliane Quijano. The program offers the latest headlines, original reporting and in-depth pieces that add context and perspective to the world's events.

programme.title: 60 Minutes
programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. Topics range from hard news coverage to politics, lifestyle, pop culture, business, health, and science. The correspondents and contributors include Lesley Stahl, Scott Pelley, Anderson Cooper, Bill Whitaker, Sharyn Alfonsi, Jon Wertheim and Norah O'Donnell .

programme.title: RAZOR: Wooden Windmills
programme.desc: As we shift to green energy, it's important to ask—how green is the infrastructure itself? Take wind power: a typical onshore turbine needs around 480 tonnes of steel, and producing just one tonne of steel or cement releases up to two tonnes of CO2. In Sweden, engineers at Modvion are tackling this problem by building wind turbine towers out of wood. RAZOR meets the team behind Wind of Change, one of the tallest wooden towers in the world. Co-founder David Olivegren got the idea while building a boat, while CEO Otto Lundman explains how sustainably sourced wood is turned into strong, lightweight Laminated Veneer Lumber (LVL). CFO Maria-Lina Hedlund shares how the company aims to scale in a competitive green energy market.

programme.title: RAZOR: Predicting Volcanic Eruptions
programme.desc: Volcanoes rank among Earth's most powerful natural forces, shaping 80% of our planet's surface. Iceland, known as the land of fire and ice, owes its dynamic terrain to its location on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, a tectonic boundary where the Eurasian and North American plates diverge. The frequent and varied eruptions here are a subject of great scientific interest. RAZOR's Reya El-Salahi meets a team of Volcanologists at the Nordic Volcanological Centre, at the University of Iceland, to find out how they are studying the most recent string of eruptions to uncover new details about this powerful geological process.

programme.title: Start small, dream big: Young entrepreneurs shape our future
programme.desc: Tune in to #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions! Hear the incredible stories of the young entrepreneurs who are doing things differently. One connects beauty services with people in need, while the other turns waste into sustainable solutions, all while lifting up their communities. Don’t you miss this!

programme.title: Startup Secrets & Backstage Gossip! #GlobalSouthNextGen Behind the scenes
programme.desc: Ever thought of turning human hair waste into sustainable products? How can young people take their first step in initiating their own business? At Suzhou Pingjiang Cultural Center, another episode of #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions invites two young entrepreneurs to share their amazing stories. Click into the BehindTheScenes video to find out more!

programme.title: Discovering Guizhou: The Guitar Fanatic
programme.desc: In Zheng'an County, Guizhou province, a thriving guitar manufacturing industry has emerged, supplying major international brands and providing thousands of jobs. In this episode, we meet the guitar-makers, the musicians, and the dreamers who've transformed an entire region by turning strings into stories.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: How to build a digital twin of a city？
programme.desc: As cities expand and grow more intricate, a new kind of specialist is emerging behind the scenes: the urban digital twin engineer. In the coastal city of Qingdao, these experts are using real-time data and AI to build virtual replicas of the city—helping predict risks, improve infrastructure, and protect the public. CGTN's Liu Jiaxin takes us inside this fast-growing field.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: From trash to treasure
programme.desc: Jiao Jianwei is a senior engineer at the Longgang Energy Eco-Park inShenzhen. Every day, the facility processes 5,000 tonnes of waste, burning it togenerate electricity that powers millions of homes. The leftover ash is alsoturned into eco-bricks, used to pave city roads. From landfills to incineration,China has transformed its waste industry with advanced technologies. Today,the country operates more than 1,000 waste-to-energy plants – nearly half theworld's total. With national goals like "carbon neutrality" and "zero-wastecities" taking shape, engineers like Jiao are turning trash into treasure.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who runs China's sea-roving protein factory?
programme.desc: Ever seen "fishermen" farming salmon on a vessel with a displacement bigger than some aircraft carriers? On China's Suhai-1 – the world's first deep-sea salmon and trout aquaculture vessel – these cold-water, high-latitude fish are now thriving far from their natural habitat.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: China's Drone Show Flight Planners
programme.desc: From the skies above Chongqing, thousands of drones light up the night in dazzling displays. Behind the spectacle, a new generation of artists and engineers is redefining entertainment – and showcasing China's growing technological and economic ambitions. In this story, we take a look at the work of a drone show flight planner.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Standing with sea giants
programme.desc: Along China's eastern shoreline, a new generation of energy workers is redefining what it meansto go to work. For offshore wind engineers, the office is the open sea. In this episode of ourspecial series Jobs 2.0, CGTN reporter Wang Tianyu takes us aboard to follow an engineer livingand working above the waves.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who's teaching the robots to work?
programme.desc: As robots gradually move from research labs into real-world tasks, a key question emerges: how do machines learn to handle complex, delicate work? At a Beijing robotics company, engineers are hand-training robotic hands, translating human experience into digital skills that can be replicated at scale. CGTN's Yang Xinmeng explores this emerging profession, speaking with the people who teach machines to cook, care, and manipulate objects with precision. Their work offers a rare glimpse into the intersection of human ingenuity and artificial intelligence – and into the ways humans and robots may collaborate in everyday life.

programme.title: KOLs and other ways to connect cultures
programme.desc: In what ways can KOLs better use their power in an age where a single video can reach millions? Tune in to #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions, and check out the stories of two KOLs from Ghana and Indonesia who use their creativity, empathy, and the shared desire to make people understand each other a little better.

programme.title: KOL traffic secrets: the power to drive change #GlobalSouthNextGen Behind the scenes
programme.desc: How do creators build traffic on social media? How can that influence spark real changes in society? In a cozy siheyuan, the iconic Beijing courtyard, another episode of #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions brings together two KOLs who open up about their journeys, their strategies, and the impact from their content. Click into the Behind the Scenes video to find out more!

programme.title: Auto China: Driving future of mobility
programme.desc: Auto China 2026 opens on April 24, showcasing nearly 1,500 vehicles over 10 days – at a pivotal turning point for China's automotive industry. Amid commodity volatility and fractured supply chains, electrification is no longer a question of “if” but “how fast.” As the world’s largest electric vehicle (EV) market and a major force of global EV sales, how is China shaping the pace and direction of this charge towards greener, smarter vehicles? Join us on BizTalk this week as we explore how China and Germany are moving in step toward the next phase of the future of mobility.

programme.title: Highland industries, high-quality future
programme.desc: From smart ranching to vegetable greenhouses, from cold-chain logistics to cross-border trade… We take a look at Xizang's industrial transformation and see how the plateau is leaping into a new era of development.

programme.title: Meet China
programme.desc: CGTN launches a brand-new original program, Meet China, dedicated to showcasing China's vitality, strength, and potential. The program covers a wide range of topics, including the economy, innovation, culture, and exploration. Join us on a journey to experience the vibrant pulse of China's economy and immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Around China: Step Into Xishuangbanna’s Everyday Life at the Ganlanba Market
programme.desc: Beneath the Ganlanba Bridge in Xishuangbanna, a local market has become part of everyday life for residents. From street-side snacks to regional specialties like ganbai chicken and sticky rice cakes, the market is filled with the sights, sounds and flavors of daily life. Guided by local residents, CGTN reporter Elle Liao takes you inside the market to capture the most authentic rhythm of life in Yunnan.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: RAZOR: Wooden Windmills
programme.desc: As we shift to green energy, it's important to ask—how green is the infrastructure itself? Take wind power: a typical onshore turbine needs around 480 tonnes of steel, and producing just one tonne of steel or cement releases up to two tonnes of CO2. In Sweden, engineers at Modvion are tackling this problem by building wind turbine towers out of wood. RAZOR meets the team behind Wind of Change, one of the tallest wooden towers in the world. Co-founder David Olivegren got the idea while building a boat, while CEO Otto Lundman explains how sustainably sourced wood is turned into strong, lightweight Laminated Veneer Lumber (LVL). CFO Maria-Lina Hedlund shares how the company aims to scale in a competitive green energy market.

programme.title: RAZOR: Predicting Volcanic Eruptions
programme.desc: Volcanoes rank among Earth's most powerful natural forces, shaping 80% of our planet's surface. Iceland, known as the land of fire and ice, owes its dynamic terrain to its location on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, a tectonic boundary where the Eurasian and North American plates diverge. The frequent and varied eruptions here are a subject of great scientific interest. RAZOR's Reya El-Salahi meets a team of Volcanologists at the Nordic Volcanological Centre, at the University of Iceland, to find out how they are studying the most recent string of eruptions to uncover new details about this powerful geological process.

programme.desc: In Zheng'an County, Guizhou province, a thriving guitar manufacturing industry has emerged, supplying major international brands and providing thousands of jobs. In this episode, we meet the guitar-makers, the musicians, and the dreamers who've transformed an entire region by turning strings into stories.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: How to build a digital twin of a city？
programme.desc: As cities expand and grow more intricate, a new kind of specialist is emerging behind the scenes: the urban digital twin engineer. In the coastal city of Qingdao, these experts are using real-time data and AI to build virtual replicas of the city—helping predict risks, improve infrastructure, and protect the public. CGTN's Liu Jiaxin takes us inside this fast-growing field.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: From trash to treasure
programme.desc: Jiao Jianwei is a senior engineer at the Longgang Energy Eco-Park inShenzhen. Every day, the facility processes 5,000 tonnes of waste, burning it togenerate electricity that powers millions of homes. The leftover ash is alsoturned into eco-bricks, used to pave city roads. From landfills to incineration,China has transformed its waste industry with advanced technologies. Today,the country operates more than 1,000 waste-to-energy plants – nearly half theworld's total. With national goals like "carbon neutrality" and "zero-wastecities" taking shape, engineers like Jiao are turning trash into treasure.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who runs China's sea-roving protein factory?
programme.desc: Ever seen "fishermen" farming salmon on a vessel with a displacement bigger than some aircraft carriers? On China's Suhai-1 – the world's first deep-sea salmon and trout aquaculture vessel – these cold-water, high-latitude fish are now thriving far from their natural habitat.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: China's Drone Show Flight Planners
programme.desc: From the skies above Chongqing, thousands of drones light up the night in dazzling displays. Behind the spectacle, a new generation of artists and engineers is redefining entertainment – and showcasing China's growing technological and economic ambitions. In this story, we take a look at the work of a drone show flight planner.

programme.desc: In Almería, the Garners help friends Lynn and Della find a modern bolthole with a community feel. Charlotte Rodriguez treats Barry and Mandy to Alicante's sun-soaked options. (S9 Ep11)

programme.title: Channel 4 News
programme.desc: Channel 4's flagship news programme. Including the weather.

programme.title: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or...
programme.desc: ...List It: Brilliant Builds: Kirstie and Phil look back at Andy and Jess Tuck's grand renovation of their cramped three-bed semi in Long Eaton. Did they manage it on a shoestring budget?

programme.title: The Dog House
programme.desc: Rocky the bulldog has had a much-needed facelift for his date, but only has eyes for a toy avocado. Muddy puddle enthusiast Grady the lurcher is looking for a new thrill. (S6 Ep2)

programme.title: New: Virgin Island
programme.desc: It's the Dating Phase of the course. As some of the virgins work to overcome their anxieties, Tegan struggles for self-acceptance. But for two members sparks really start to fly. (S2 Ep3)

programme.title: Love Cheats: The Fake Lord
programme.desc: True crime series following extraordinary stories of romance fraud and the fight to bring con artists to justice. A fake lord cheats his victims out of thousands. (Ep1/4)

programme.title: Super Surgeons: A Chance at Life
programme.desc: Peter has a fast-growing tumour and needs throat reconstruction to save his life. Janet's pancreatic cancer is wrapped around a vital vein - can the growth be removed? (S1 Ep2/3)

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Harmony Keepers: Guardians of milu deer
programme.desc: This documentary series pays tribute to the guardians of China’s rare wildlife and their habitats. Through the lens of ecological protection and preservation, the series features four iconic protected species in China: the Tibetan antelope, milu deer, black-necked cranes, and golden snub-nosed monkeys.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, to meet more outstanding women from the cities of Hengyang and Zhuzhou. By documenting snippets of the daily lives and work of a paper-cutting artist, the director of the Hengyang Huagu Opera Troupe, and an inheritor of Liling porcelain craftsmanship, we gain vivid insights into the distinctive cultural traditions of this region.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, traveling to the cities of Zhuzhou and Xiangtan to meet another group of extraordinary women. By capturing snippets of the lives and work of an electric locomotive designer, a flight instructor, a painter, and a poverty alleviation volunteer, we showcase the unique cultural and humanistic charm of this region.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River
programme.desc: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River is a documentary focusing on the World Heritage sites and cultural–ecological conservation in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. Through the lens of Ningxia’s heritage stories, the film highlights China’s commitment to World Heritage preservation, ecological restoration, and cultural continuity — presenting to global audiences a land where history and modernity intertwine, and where desert and oasis coexist. By following the guardians of the Western Xia Imperial Tombs, desert restorers in the Tengger Desert, Great Wall rangers at Sanguankou, traditional sheepskin raft craftsmen, and managers of the Yellow River irrigation system in Qingtongxia, the program reveals Ningxia’s distinctive contributions to cultural heritage, natural ecology, and intangible traditions — and the enduring human spirit behind them.

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper
programme.desc: The host travels to Jingxian, Anhui—known as the hometown of Xuan paper—to experience the intricate process of making this traditional paper. Along the way, they uncover the secrets behind its thousand-year legacy and witness the craftsmanship of Xuan paper inheritors at every stage. Through vivid, personal stories, the episode reveals the hidden struggles and quiet perseverance that have kept this intangible cultural heritage alive across generations.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: CULTURAL INHERITORS Inheritance matters more than fame
programme.desc: The Vibe production team's meticulously crafted documentary series "Cultural Inheritors". The eight episodes span across various regions of China, focusing on the inheritors and artists of intangible cultural heritage. They explore and innovate with artisanal dedication, showcasing the extraordinary craftsmanship of fields such as the Ru Kiln porcelain, colored stone inlay, Pu'er tea, and Lingnan woodwork. Let’s embark on a cultural journey together, savoring the beauty of tradition and embracing the spirit of intangible cultural heritage!

programme.title: Miao Embroidery: History in Stitches
programme.desc: According to legend, during a migration by the Miao ethnic group, a female chieftain wanted to keep a record of all the mountains and lakes she passed along the way. The means she chose of doing so was by stitching the images on her dress. By the time they reached a suitable place to settle, her clothing was covered with embroidered designs. This, it’s said, was the origin of Miao embroidery. As the story tells us, the designs in Miao embroidery are closely related to the natural world and daily life. The Miao people have a special fondness for nature. So, as well as depicting their daily farming and work activities, they copy birds, flowers, mountains, and grass onto their clothing. Over the years, the embroidery of the Miao people has become a written record of their life. The stitches are like characters which, when many of them are combined, become a record of their history, their collected wisdom, and the knowledge passed down from their ancestors.

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Our lens turns to the "Xiangjiang Ladies" who work in Changsha’s high-tech and equipment manufacturing sectors. Their daily lives and professional endeavors reflect the city’s innovative vitality, while their after-work gatherings also showcase the dazzling night views along both banks of the Xiangjiang River, highlighting Changsha’s distinct charm as a vibrant capital of leisure and entertainment.

programme.title: The Art of Harmony: Human Becoming
programme.desc: “The Art of Harmony” is a documentary about Confucianism, produced by CGTN and Discovery Channel. It highlights the timeless nature of the sage’s philosophy and its global relevance today. Join us in exploring how the world might benefit from the pursuit of “The Art of Harmony”.

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai’s Yushu Prefecture is one of China’s key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders’ daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

programme.title: China Bound: Tianjin
programme.desc: Tianran He explores the vibrant port city of Tianjin. Strolling through its historic quarters, he discovers how old buildings are being preserved and revitalized, and savors the rich flavors of authentic Tianjin cuisine. To work off the calories, he joins energetic retirees for a morning workout in the park, then takes in the lively nightlife along the banks of the Haihe River. From folk handicrafts on Ancient Culture Street to the National Maritime Museum and an aircraft carrier theme park, Tianran discovers that Tianjin is a truly multifacted city.

programme.title: Young star on green field
programme.desc: Meet Sun Chenxi, a 12-year-old soccer "star" from Ningbo who first picked up the game at the age of four and is already playing with the confidence of a veteran. Sun says he dreams of turning pro one day and leading China's men's team to the World Cup. Dribbling and passing with skills far more advanced than his age, he has won over audiences far and wide after his father posted clips of Sun flashing his fancy footwork on social media. The soon-to-be-teenager now has millions of followers online. Already recognized as a rising young talent, high hopes are pinned on Sun as he is cheered on by his parents, friends, and throngs of fans online.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music.” The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Kesi
programme.desc: Silk is a classic symbol of Chinese culture. It helped opened up economic and cultural exchanges between East and West and witnessed the spread of Eastern civilization to the world. As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of “an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold.”

programme.title: Miao Silverware: A Shining Epic
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the fascinating world of the silver-working art of the Miao ethnic group. Join us, and hear the stories and see the works of four remarkable individuals. From a national-level inheritor who is preserving the traditional craft, to an artist infusing personal flair into his designs; from a female silversmith imbuing her work with feminine warmth, to a young artisan inspiring a new generation, we investigate the rich heritage, cultural significance, and evolving potential of Miao silverware.

Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Kesi
programme.desc: Silk is a classic symbol of Chinese culture. It helped opened up economic and cultural exchanges between East and West and witnessed the spread of Eastern civilization to the world. As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of “an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold.”

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper
programme.desc: The host travels to Jingxian, Anhui—known as the hometown of Xuan paper—to experience the intricate process of making this traditional paper. Along the way, they uncover the secrets behind its thousand-year legacy and witness the craftsmanship of Xuan paper inheritors at every stage. Through vivid, personal stories, the episode reveals the hidden struggles and quiet perseverance that have kept this intangible cultural heritage alive across generations.

programme.title: CULTURAL INHERITORS Inheritance matters more than fame
programme.desc: The Vibe production team's meticulously crafted documentary series "Cultural Inheritors". The eight episodes span across various regions of China, focusing on the inheritors and artists of intangible cultural heritage. They explore and innovate with artisanal dedication, showcasing the extraordinary craftsmanship of fields such as the Ru Kiln porcelain, colored stone inlay, Pu'er tea, and Lingnan woodwork. Let’s embark on a cultural journey together, savoring the beauty of tradition and embracing the spirit of intangible cultural heritage!

programme.title: Miao Silverware: A Shining Epic
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the fascinating world of the silver-working art of the Miao ethnic group. Join us, and hear the stories and see the works of four remarkable individuals. From a national-level inheritor who is preserving the traditional craft, to an artist infusing personal flair into his designs; from a female silversmith imbuing her work with feminine warmth, to a young artisan inspiring a new generation, we investigate the rich heritage, cultural significance, and evolving potential of Miao silverware.

programme.title: Xinjiang On the Road
programme.desc: Join an international group on an ice-snow adventure across northern Xinjiang, exploring stunning winter scenery, rich ethnic culture and warm hospitality from Urumqi to Altay.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Our lens turns to the "Xiangjiang Ladies" who work in Changsha’s high-tech and equipment manufacturing sectors. Their daily lives and professional endeavors reflect the city’s innovative vitality, while their after-work gatherings also showcase the dazzling night views along both banks of the Xiangjiang River, highlighting Changsha’s distinct charm as a vibrant capital of leisure and entertainment.

programme.title: The Art of Harmony: Human Becoming
programme.desc: “The Art of Harmony” is a documentary about Confucianism, produced by CGTN and Discovery Channel. It highlights the timeless nature of the sage’s philosophy and its global relevance today. Join us in exploring how the world might benefit from the pursuit of “The Art of Harmony”.

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai’s Yushu Prefecture is one of China’s key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders’ daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

programme.title: China Bound: Tianjin
programme.desc: Tianran He explores the vibrant port city of Tianjin. Strolling through its historic quarters, he discovers how old buildings are being preserved and revitalized, and savors the rich flavors of authentic Tianjin cuisine. To work off the calories, he joins energetic retirees for a morning workout in the park, then takes in the lively nightlife along the banks of the Haihe River. From folk handicrafts on Ancient Culture Street to the National Maritime Museum and an aircraft carrier theme park, Tianran discovers that Tianjin is a truly multifacted city.

programme.title: Young star on green field
programme.desc: Meet Sun Chenxi, a 12-year-old soccer "star" from Ningbo who first picked up the game at the age of four and is already playing with the confidence of a veteran. Sun says he dreams of turning pro one day and leading China's men's team to the World Cup. Dribbling and passing with skills far more advanced than his age, he has won over audiences far and wide after his father posted clips of Sun flashing his fancy footwork on social media. The soon-to-be-teenager now has millions of followers online. Already recognized as a rising young talent, high hopes are pinned on Sun as he is cheered on by his parents, friends, and throngs of fans online.

programme.title: Tutankhamun: Life, Death and Legacy

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky (2024)
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.desc: De Parker Solar Probe Mission van NASA is onderweg, en binnenkort zal Europa ook hun Solar Probe Mission lanceren. Geen enkel ruimtevaartuig heeft eerder zo snel of zo dicht langs een ster gereisd. Men hoopt zo de bron van de zonnewinden te analyseren die ons op Aarde raken.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4
programme.desc: Commerciële ruimtevaartbedrijven zoals SpaceX, Virgin Galactic en Blue Origin zijn steeds dichterbij het moment dat ze kunnen lanceren. Betalende klanten zullen binnenkort de ruimte in gaan en hun vluchten worden beschouwd als een nieuwe stap in de ruimtevaart.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4
programme.desc: De gezamenlijke Bepi-Colombo-missie van ESA en JAXA wordt binnenkort gelanceerd. Het doelwit is Mercurius, een planeet die lang genegeerd werd door onderzoekers. Deze missie zal nieuw licht werpen op deze vreemde wereld van licht en donker.

programme.title: Angry Planet S1
programme.desc: Host George Kourounis has braved many terrifying phenomena – but none as frightening as the one he takes on in this episode: marriage!

programme.title: Angry Planet S1
programme.desc: George travels to Guadaloupe Island off the coast of Mexico to dive with 16 foot Great White Sharks. He then uses drysuit and kayak to retrace the explorations of Tom Woodward into a flooded Northern Ontario cave in the middle of winter.

programme.title: Angry Planet S1
programme.desc: Avalanche danger is very high in the Rogers Pass area of the Trans Canada Highway in British Columbia. Host of Angry Planet George Kourounis travels with a variety of experts to bring down huge avalanches in the Rocky Mountains.

programme.title: Ghost Chasers S2
programme.desc: Josh keert terug naar de Paterei-gevangenis in Estland, waar het boosaardige regime dood en verderf heeft gezaaid, om op zoek te gaan naar boze geesten en energieën uit een ver verleden.

programme.title: Ghost Chasers S2
programme.desc: Bepaalde gevangenen komen nooit vrij. Vindt Cody de eeuwige gevangen op een klein eiland, dat ook wel het 'Kroaatse Alcatraz' genoemd wordt?

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S5
programme.desc: Spangler en Higginsworth verkennen het Museum of Science in Boston op zoek naar nieuwe doe-het-zelf wetenschapstrucs en experimenten.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S5
programme.desc: Nadat hij zich jarenlang het mikpunt van alle grappen van Steve Spangler heeft gevoeld, dreigt rechterhand Higginsworth met vertrek als Steve niet ophoudt met zijn geintjes.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S5
programme.desc: Steve Spangler's rechterhand Higginsworth raakt in paniek wanneer hij een wetenschappelijk onderzoeksproject moet presenteren.

programme.title: Bright Now S1
programme.desc: Weinig films hebben een grotere impact gehad op de Amerikaanse psyche dan 'Woodstock'. Producent Dale Bell vertelt wat er nodig was om de revolutionaire documentaire te maken die het bepalende moment van de tegencultuur van de jaren 1960 vastlegde.

programme.title: Bright Now S1
programme.desc: Artsen, chef-koks en voedingsdeskundigen laten ons zien hoe we kunnen vergroenen met verse ingrediënten en smaken in onze dagelijkse maaltijden, en dat onze gezondheid zal bevorderen.

programme.title: Bright Now S1
programme.desc: Door domesticatie werden wolven honden en veranderde zowel hun gedrag als hun anatomie. Nieuwe ontdekkingen laten zien hoe honden vaker een zeer specifieke wenkbrauwbeweging maken dan wolven.

programme.title: Earthrise S1
programme.desc: We kijken naar methoden voor grondherstel en natuurbehoud nu menselijke oorzaken en klimaatverandering verwoestingen aanrichten.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S1
programme.desc: Ga mee met de heruitvinders Matt en Jeremy terwijl ze een testvlucht maken met een oude pedaal-aangedreven helikopter.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S1
programme.desc: Laten we kijken of een beetje vertrouwen en heel hard trappen ervoor kunnen zorgen dat deze 19e-eeuwse vliegmachine van de grond kan komen.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S1
programme.desc: Is het een gek idee om je toilet op te blazen? Bekijk deze aflevering om erachter te komen.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1
programme.desc: In deze aflevering gaat Bones naar Zuid-Korea, waar hij een Taekwondogroep, de K Tigers, bezoekt, evenals een tarotkaartlezer, en onthult het geheim van het perfect kaarten schudden.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1
programme.desc: Deze keer is Magical Bones in Seoul. Hij gaat naar de B-Boy kampioenschappen, bezoekt zijn vriend Ji en doet een spectaculaire truc op een shirt.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1
programme.desc: In deze aflevering gaat Pete de straat op in Delhi, de hoofdstad van India. Hij voert allerlei leuke, verbluffende trucs uit, waaronder een poging tot zweven.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel: The Renovation Diaries
programme.desc: De eigenaar van Kestrel Beer koopt een originele Riley Kestrel uit 1930 met de intentie deze te herstellen en er daarna het snelheidsrecord op het land mee te verbreken.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1
programme.desc: Dave krijgt te maken met een rommelige trein, J.P. zaagt een boom om, Regional Crane tilt een enorme muur en Maxum Crane verplaatst een bank naar een hoog gebouw.

programme.title: Rob Schmitt This Week
programme.desc: Rob Schmitt wraps up all the latest news and opinion and sets the stage for tomorrow.

programme.title: Presidents and UFOs: The Surprising Story
programme.desc: A history of UFO's and Presidents, from George Washington to Donald Trump, with expert testimony, interviews, and reports of personal encounters involving U.S. Presidents and unexplained paranormal phenomena.

programme.title: Unearthed
programme.desc: Unearthed in 1980, an objective, scientific look at what is supposed to be the tomb of Jesus.

programme.title: Doomsday In Pompeii
programme.desc: In 79AD Mount Vesuvius erupted, covering the surrounding cities with a thick layer of volcanic ash, pumice, and mud. One such city was Pompeii. The remains show details of the everyday lives of Romans thousands of years ago.

programme.title: Cult of Personality
programme.desc: The 1993 Waco siege was a 51-day standoff that ended in a fire killing 80 people, with some believing the Branch Davidians were deliberately targeted and still viewing leader David Koresh as Christ incarnate.

programme.title: Coolidge: Rediscovering an American President
programme.desc: Calvin Coolidge - the man Ronald Reagan called "one of our most underrated presidents." Coolidge led America through an era of booming prosperity, slashed taxes and debt.

programme.title: The '80s: Decade of Decision
programme.desc: In the 1980s Wall Street boomed! Greed was good, and so were big hair, Rubik's Cube, personal computers, Madonna, flying DeLoreans, and so much more! Take a step back in time to relive this era of self-indulgence.

programme.title: The Wild Geese
programme.desc: A mercenary team comes out of retirement to rescue a kidnapped African leader. While the 'Wild Geese' are fighting and dying in the African sun, sinister figures are working to seal their fate. Cast: Richard Burton, Roger Moore, Richard Harris

programme.title: Awakening: Jesus in Bethlehem
programme.desc: Dimitris Chermantas brings the Gospel to life retracing the events of the Birth of Jesus Christ, from Nazareth to Bethlehem.

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Join host Tevya Heller on this cultural journey in his search for God. It's an inviting and insightful look at the spiritual teachings, customs, and daily lives of families of different faiths.

programme.title: Finding the Mountain of Moses: The Real Mt. Sinai
programme.desc: Undeniable archaeological evidence of the real location of Mount Sinai -- plus advanced research based on Christian, Jewish, and Islamic sources that indicates Mount Sinai is in Saudi Arabia!

programme.title: The Big Focus
programme.desc: John Bachman focuses on the biggest news from D.C., N.Y., and around America!

programme.title: The Freedom File: Judge Napolitano
programme.desc: Judge Napolitano provides commentary on current events, drawing on his expertise in constitutional law to protect individual freedoms in his legal and political news coverage.

programme.title: David Harris Jr. The Pulse Weekly
programme.desc: David Harris Jr. delivers hard-hitting analysis and opinion of the latest news and events.

programme.title: Carl Higbie This Week
programme.desc: Carl Higbie gives common-sense news analysis, exposes big government and media bias, as he fights for American values.

programme.title: Ed Henry The Big Take Weekly
programme.desc: Ed Henry offers his common-sense take on the news, helping viewers better understand the deeper details behind today's stories.

programme.title: Greg Kelly This Week
programme.desc: Greg Kelly gives hardest-hitting reports and analysis from L.A. to N.Y., from Beltway to Rust Belt, talking with you and for you!

programme.title: Rob Carson’s What in the World?
programme.desc: Rob Carson dissects politics, cultural phenomena, and absurdity confronting us every day in America with humor and satire.

programme.title: Newsfront
programme.desc: Russia and China combined may have twice as many nuclear weapons as the United States within a decade. The United States must modernize its aging nuclear arsenal.

programme.title: Rob Schmitt This Week
programme.desc: Rob Schmitt wraps up all the latest news and opinion and sets the stage for tomorrow.

programme.title: Newsmax News In-Depth
programme.desc: Bianca de la Garza looks at the big stories of the week, politics, policy, the economy, and much more!

programme.title: The Record With Greta Van Susteren Weekly
programme.desc: Greta Van Susteren gives the big news from D.C., N.Y., across America, and around the world.

programme.title: Finnerty Weekly
programme.desc: "Finnerty Weekend" with straight talk on the biggest issues facing America and the world!

programme.title: Wise Guys With John Tabacco
programme.desc: John Tabacco and his crew look at the big issues, shining a light on hypocrisy and dangerous policies of the elites.

programme.title: The Royal Visit
programme.desc: Bob Brooks and Katrina Szish present highlights of King Charles III and Queen Camilla's U.S. state visit, including his address to Congress and the White House state dinner.

programme.title: The Dean Martin Celebrity Roast
programme.desc: Dean Martin hosts a celebrity-studded roast honoring comedian, actor, and philanthropist Danny Thomas, with friends and fellow celebrities delivering sharp jabs and warm tributes.

programme.title: JFK Remembered: 50 Years Later
programme.desc: Look back at the astounding 1000-day Presidency of John F. Kennedy, filled with dramatic moments, like the Bay of Pigs Invasion, the Cuban Missile Crisis, and his tragic death by assassination on November 22, 1963.

programme.title: JFK's Women: The Scandals Revealed
programme.desc: An explosive biography that reveals the real John Fitzgerald Kennedy - a president who was prepared to risk his political career and, at the height of the Cold War, his country's security, to indulge in sex.

programme.title: Fame Kills: Princess Diana
programme.desc: Princess Diana's life was complicated, and it ended tragically. The fame and public admiration, although well intentioned, is what ultimately killed her.

programme.title: Harry and Meghan: The Great Divide
programme.desc: Prince Harry and Meghan fled the royal family for a chance at private life. They shared their story to set the record straight, but it became a great divide.

programme.title: Voices of Valor
programme.desc: Carl Higbie sits down with three fellow veterans to discuss topics like the failures of the VA, how weak American society has become, and the difficulties veterans face when returning to civilian life.

programme.title: First Edition
programme.desc: Start your day with a thorough overview of the latest news, insightful commentary, and expert analysis.

programme.title: News Now
programme.desc: Host Shannon Cake brings you live reporting, global field updates and insight-rich interviews shaping the day's high-stakes stories.

programme.title: National Update

programme.title: John Bachman Now

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun (2015)
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Night Fire (2010)
programme.desc: The Northern Lights are more than just beautiful; they tell us about the make up of our planet, our sun, and may even be a signpost for the possibility of life on other planets.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Virtual Universe (2010)
programme.desc: Our understanding of the cosmos is limited by the amount of time we have to see it. Fortunately, computer simulations can help us see how galaxies interact over millions of years, and even how dark matter structures the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise (2010)
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance (2010)
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Superscopes (2010)
programme.desc: Discover the most powerful telescopes on the planet as they search for the mysteries of the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow (2010)
programme.desc: The human eye can only see visible light, a small spectrum of electromagnetic waves. Today, we have instruments that let us perceive all wavelengths.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn (2012)
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it’s also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood. | Cast: Ivan Semeniuk

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled (2012)
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered. | Cast: Ivan Semeniuk

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds (2012)
programme.desc: They key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case. | Cast: Ivan Semeniuk

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity (2012)
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon. | Cast: Ivan Semeniuk

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle (2012)
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead. | Cast: Ivan Semeniuk

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars (2013)
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit. | Cast: Ivan Semeniuk

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way (2012)
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient skywatchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out. | Cast: Ivan Semeniuk

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang (2012)
programme.desc: When it comes to the birth of the universe, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the Big Bang. | Cast: Ivan Semeniuk

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone (2012)
programme.desc: Mercury is one of Earth's closest neighbors, but until very recent exploratory missions, it eluded astronomers' best efforts to learn its secrets. | Cast: Ivan Semeniuk

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays (2013)
programme.desc: Cosmic rays can tell us much about the universe. They are not simply another form of light, but carriers of information about powerful and unseen processes at work thousands or even millions of light years away.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Fermi Paradox (2012)
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: why have alien civilizations not presented themselves? | Cast: Ivan Semeniuk

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat (2012)
programme.desc: An advanced $900 million planetary explorer designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal intricate details undetectable by the human eye. | Cast: Ivan Semeniuk

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Eye of the Beholder (2013)

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Painted By Light (2013)
programme.desc: When the universe formed, all of space blazed white-hot, but it didn't last. Darkness reined for 200 million years before the light was reborn. | Cast: Ivan Semeniuk

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Colour (2013)
programme.desc: Color is essential to both art and astronomy. When measured, it can tell us the temperature, chemical composition, and motion of astronomical objects. | Cast: Ivan Semeniuk

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Perspective (2013)
